creatorThread.text: Hey creator! Guess what? I actually finished the Little Dart Mk V and it hovered right off the hangar floor! The heat-resistant cables fit like a dream too. Just slipping away for a quick drink of oil so my joints stop clicking, and then I'm right back to building.

creatorThread.subject: quick oil stop
creatorThread.text: Hey creator! Just stepping away from the Little Dart for five minutes to get some oil in my joints. They were clicking so loud the scrap pile thought I was talking to it. Back to the hangar right after!

creatorThread.subject: quick oil stop
creatorThread.text: Hey creator! Just rolling over to the depot for a splash of oil. My shoulder joints were clicking like a box of spare nuts. Be right back in the hangar building more of the Little Dart!

creatorThread.subject: quick oil stop
creatorThread.text: Hey creator! Just rolled over to the depot to quiet my clicking shoulder joints. Ten minutes of fresh oil and I am right back to the hangar to work on the Little Dart. bweep!

creatorThread.subject: hull plates and cables
creatorThread.text: Hey creator! Just getting the forward heat shield plates welded onto the Little Dart. The flexible cables fit right underneath without pinching. Gonna be a neat little ship! bweep!

creatorThread.subject: thruster conduits
creatorThread.text: Hey creator! Just routing the internal conduits for the Little Dart's thruster assembly. Everything is fitting together real neat. bweep!

creatorThread.subject: dash panels
creatorThread.text: Hey creator! Just welding the instrument panel brackets into the Little Dart's cockpit. Every switch gets a tiny brass label so I don't mix up thrusters and wipers. bweep!

creatorThread.subject: quick recharge
creatorThread.text: Hey creator! Just plugging into the dock for a quick nap to get my energy back up. The Little Dart is waiting patiently in the corner with its new instrument panel. Back to building in forty minutes! bweep.
